name: Constant
summary: Wait the same amount every time. Fastest to notice a short outage, and the purest form of the thundering herd: every client comes back at the same instant, forever.

params.name: baseMs
params.description: The delay before every retry, in milliseconds.

params.name: maxAttempts
params.description: Give up after this many attempts.

notes: The policy you get by accident when nobody thought about it: sleep(100) in a loop.
